limits: Bounded current-image and source-point integration; no claim of entire source website parity, physical device, routing or every historical feature rerun.
capture_method: Installed local Playwright CLI through its run-code command; actual page screenshots, drag, zoom, filtering and refresh. No Playwright test files. npm wrapper unavailable offline; existing installed CLI used without installation.

native_comparison.method: Crop previous and new formal WebP images through exactly equal camera/roof records; identical crop coordinates, no image colour edits, scale at most one native pixel per output pixel.
native_comparison.limitations: Different-campus reference parity and unchanged pixels are not claimed. Original source-tree name/prototype allocation can differ across native processes; separate source protection records apply. Crops are selected finish regions, not the whole map.
